title: Hermes Arcana field evidence
working_hypothesis: Lexicon + Arcana appears most useful when repository uncertainty is structural, and adds little once the working set is already narrow and directly searchable.

positive_or_boundary_cases.contribution: connected duplicated fallback policy and credential-pool state across Desktop and live-agent paths
narrowed writer class and exposed missing TypeScript callable/call graph coverage
eliminated ordinary static write paths and justified switch to runtime SQL tracing
mapped Gateway-to-CLI ownership coupling and migration seams
supported verification of micro-compaction persistence/call structure

low_benefit_or_control_cases.observation: direct source inspection sufficient while Lexicon/Arcana unavailable
compact working set; structured graph discovery not materially necessary
localized behavior; direct inspection and regression test sufficient
full structural machinery unnecessary until ownership analysis became the bottleneck

limitations: public outcomes do not isolate causal contribution
investigations mixed Arcana with ordinary developer tools
